name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword — wiiking2.sav

skip.label: File {n} cutscenes seen
skip.description: Per-file cutscene-seen bits: 16 big-endian words of flags, then their CRC32 (the decompilation's SavedSaveFiles.skipData). skip.dat beside the save holds the same three chunks. The game wipes a chunk to zero and re-signs it when its CRC is wrong, and when a file is cleared.

tail.label: Trailer
tail.description: 0x14 bytes after the cutscene block, unknown (unk2 in the decompilation). Zero in every save seen.

checksums.description: CRC32 of the slot's 0x53BC data bytes, stored big-endian right after them. A slot whose checksum was already wrong when the file was opened is not given a new one.

CRC32 of the chunk's 0x20 flag bytes, stored big-endian after them. The game computes it for every chunk, used or not (initSkipData, clearFileA); on load it wipes a chunk whose CRC is wrong (checkFileStatus).
